purpose: Demo fixtures for the Arena matrix rows. Fixtures only set conditions (ratings, placements, review records, curator/player roles); the app performs the rated runs. Consumers: 3.11 (conservation, prices 1/100), matrix device rows (3.4-3.10), 3.12 (season fixtures are deferred there, not seeded here).

backend.provenance: restored 2026-10-04 from firebase-export-staging/arena-e2b-cycle4-20260913 (98 anonymous auth accounts, archived ac_* quest chains) + synthetic catalog fixture chains ac_* re-written 2026-10-08 (catalogs/themes/sections/lessons). REST reads of rules-closed collections look 'empty' — they are 403; the admin-SDK view (seeder/verifier) is authoritative.

namespaceRule: Seeded fixture paths carry demoarena_; pinned preconditions (ac_* chain docs, export-era author uids, the bank-low rating) are verified, never written or rewritten — the fixture run performs zero overwrites.

roles.purpose: pinned export-era author of the arena-bank-low ac_* chain (quests/ac_0ecb34….quest.authorUid, verified); its auth account already exists in the demo backend; receives the 80% author share (AD-13/AD-9) of price-1 entries
pinned export-era author of the arena-bank-high ac_* chain (quests/ac_6ba84b00….quest.authorUid, verified); auth account already exists; receives the 80% author share of price-100 entries
trusted curator (isArenaCurator: adminLevel >= 100) for review/lifecycle views; reviewerUid of the accepted review records (must differ from the bank owners)
ordinary player, device A owner; initial balance covers price-100 entries and repeated price-1 rows
second owner for A->B->A switch and two-device rows (3.9/3.10)

banks.expectedWeightedScore: 42/21 (rating 2/1 + Bayesian prior 40/20) — pinned export-era rating, the universe minimum
banks.purpose: lowest-rated bank -> price 1; the five-payments-of-1 conservation row (author nets 4 total at 80/20)
highest-rated bank -> price 100 (two-level universe: level 1 of 2 maps to 1+99)

pinnedPreconditions.verified: version == chain.lessonVersion, themeId == chain.themeId, no archived flag
authorUid == chain.authorUid, catalogId == chain.catalogId (chain export-era docs; archived state irrelevant to the lesson context loader)

fields.seededOnly: created only when rating.seeded is true; otherwise a pinned precondition (bank-low carries its export-era 2-star rating)

pinnedPreconditionsExtra.verified: ratingSum 2, ratingCount 1, ratingVersion 1, authorUid D0h0rHZGJVoU22cADZV8yb2lz1KT (export-era 2-star rating; the universe minimum)

chainFacts.loadArenaLessonContext: lessons/{id} -> themes/{themeId}.sectionId -> sections/{sectionId}.questId -> quests/{questId}.authorUid/catalogId -> catalogs/{catalogId}.questType (REGULAR); reviewApproved requires admin review status PUBLISHED with ownerUid/questId/submissionId matching and lessonPassed over accepted records (TESTING and LOGIC both >= 2; sourceLanguages satisfied by the source language itself)
chainFacts.eligibleUniverse: lesson_placements where shelf==arena, identity-matched against the context above and lessons/{id} (version/theme), priced by assignLessonPrices over lesson_ratings (relative scale: minimum -> 1, maximum -> 100)

universeBaseline: The demo backend carries a 15-row arena universe of export-era fixtures (four ac_* chains, aeu_* targets, one lesson-UUID bank) beyond the two manifest banks. Prices are relative over the whole universe: the verifier pins bank-low at price 1 (the 2-star 42/21 score ties with unrated 40/20 rows at the bottom level, which is legitimate) and bank-high as the sole price-100 row; any future fixture that breaks an extreme fails verification instead of silently invalidating the conservation rows.

seasonFixtures.note: arena_seasons / quarter clock / 19-20 distinct pasts are 3.12 scope (§4 season fixtures); this manifest does not seed them

seeding.mechanism: firebase-admin (Firestore + Auth) against the emulators — admin path, security rules do not apply; idempotent: existing fixture docs are verified against the manifest and left, missing ones created; drift on a seeded fixture or a pinned precondition is a named refusal; never touches non-fixture docs
seeding.cleanup: remove the three seeded auth uids (demoarena_*), profiles/demoarena_*, users/demoarena_*, and the per-bank rows above (admin review docs, lesson_placements, lesson_ratings for the two pinned lesson ids); pinned preconditions are export-era residue and stay

verification.proof: runs the production createArenaEligibleUniverse with the production lesson-context loader against the demo backend (read-only) and requires the two banks to hold priceNolics 1 and 100 — the sole minimum and maximum of the whole universe
